scientific_integrity: An explicit all-width symbolic proof establishes reflection traces. Exact finite tests check perfect-matching compatibility, reflection orbit reductions, and independent signed fixed-face counts. The rotation action used for the full dihedral-module conclusion was established previously and is separately credited; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology for even ladder width n at least 4 and the natural dihedral subgroup only; neither integral homology lattices nor all graph automorphisms nor an equivariant homotopy model are determined. The nonequivariant rank and the flag presentation use the 2026 preprint. The revised preprint was not fully inspected, and unindexed equivalents may exist.
title: Reflection characters of even Möbius-ladder perfect-matching homology
